pages.title: Custom dictionaries
pages._note: Dictionaries are fetched from filinq's own PHP controller (organisation-gated, term-count-enriched) not a plain OR index endpoint — same rationale as ConsentIndex; type:custom preserves that data path.

pages.title: Custom Dictionary Detail
pages._note: Term management (add/remove/import) + metadata edit for one dictionary, fetched via customDictionaryStore. type:custom preserves the filinq-controller data path.

pages.title: Anonymization
pages._note: Anonymization uses the anonymization store (filinq API) not OpenRegister; type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: Folder Analysis
pages._note: Folder-level anonymization scan; fetches via folderAnonymizationStore (filinq API); type:custom preserves the existing data path.

pages.title: My Documents
pages._note: Hosts the in-app file viewer (FileViewerPage renders when fileViewerStore.currentFile is set). The anonymisation widget routes here after upload so the user reviews detected entities next to the document contents.
